blurb: Westpoint Marina is located on the eastern shores of Braddock Bay, Rochester's west side hidden paradise. It offers a full-service fuel dock, pump out station, Wifi, electric, fresh water, garbage disposal, full service staff, and ample free parking. The marina features a 1000' long dredged navigation channel, public boat launch, trails along Lake Ontario, and onsite marine mechanics.
